_about: The paper's bibliography. Cite with [@key] in paper/sections/*.html; build.py numbers the citations in order of first use, lists them, and writes paper/references.bib. 'role': used = CharForge runs it; compared = measured or weighed against ours; related = context. Every entry was checked against its source page on the date in 'checked'.

refs.title: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation (TRELLIS.2)
refs.note: The image-to-3D model at the centre of the character lane (4B parameters, O-Voxel latents), run through its MLX port.

refs.title: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
refs.note: TRELLIS, the predecessor of TRELLIS.2.

refs.title: trellis2mlx: TRELLIS.2 on Apple Silicon (MLX)
refs.note: The port CharForge runs, with a multi-view patch of our own.

refs.title: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation
refs.note: An alternative image-to-3D generator (shape DiT + texture painter).

refs.title: Hunyuan3D 2.1: From Images to High-Fidelity 3D Assets with Production-Ready PBR Material
refs.note: Vendored in the repository for comparison; the generator behind several hosted tools.

refs.title: CharacterGen: Efficient 3D Character Generation from Single Images with Multi-View Pose Canonicalization
refs.note: Four A-pose views from one image, a sparse-view reconstruction model, texture back-projection with depth test and Poisson blending; rigs with AccuRig. Anime3D dataset (13,746 VRoid models).

refs.title: Make-A-Character: High Quality Text-to-3D Character Generation within Minutes
refs.note: An LLM (Qwen-14B) parses the prompt into attributes; a portrait is generated and fitted onto MetaHuman topology with 431 dense landmarks; strand hair and library-matched garments; 52 blendshapes.

refs.title: Make-A-Character 2: Animatable 3D Character Generation From a Single Image
refs.note: Single portrait to animatable character in under 2 minutes: IC-Light relighting, colour correction, hierarchical face reconstruction, adaptive facial skeleton calibration.

refs.title: DrawingSpinUp: 3D Animation from Single Character Drawings
refs.note: Image-to-3D of a drawing, contour removal and restoration, skeleton-based thinning; rigs with Mixamo's auto-rigger (eight front-view keypoints) and nearest-bone weights, retargets with Rokoko. arXiv:2409.08615.

refs.title: Generation of 3D Human Models and Animations Using Simple Sketches
refs.note: A VAE from 2D stick figures to 3D point-cloud bodies, and animation by interpolating in its latent space.

refs.title: A Method for Animating Children's Drawings of the Human Figure
refs.note: 2D rigging of drawings; the baseline DrawingSpinUp compares against.

refs.title: Automatic Rigging and Animation of 3D Characters
refs.note: Embeds a template skeleton in a mesh and computes weights by heat diffusion.

refs.title: RigNet: Neural Rigging for Articulated Characters
refs.note: Learned joints, bone connectivity and skin weights.

refs.title: One Model to Rig Them All: Diverse Skeleton Rigging with UniRig
refs.note: Autoregressive skeleton prediction (skeleton tree tokenization) and skin weights; Rig-XL dataset of 14,000+ rigged models.

refs.title: AccuRIG: free automatic character rigging
refs.note: Marker-guided joint placement, finger rigging (0-5 fingers), one-click skinning for A- or T-pose meshes; used by CharacterGen.

refs.title: PINOC AI auto-rigging
refs.note: Guide markers (chin, shoulders, elbows, wrists, groin, knees, ankles) mirrored across the body, automatic weights, fingers, FBX/GLB export.

refs.title: Rig Lab: AI rigging
refs.note: Automatic humanoid joints and skinning from an A/T-pose GLB; hands are single joints (no fingers); four procedural clips.

refs.title: Mixamo: motion library and auto-rigger
refs.note: CharacterGen's peers rig with its auto-rigger; CharForge uses its skeleton naming and its motion-capture library (2,453 clips) as the motion source and retrieval database.

refs.title: Image to 3D model (free)
refs.note: Free tier: untextured OBJ at a fixed face count in about 50 s; PBR textures, GLB and higher face counts on paid tiers.

refs.title: Hunyuan3D 3D model generator
refs.note: Browser workbench on Hunyuan3D: text, one image or up to four views in; a GLB with materials, skeleton and animations out, 10K-1.5M triangles.

refs.title: AI 3D model generators: a guide
refs.note: Survey of hosted and open generators (Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Hi3D, Hunyuan 3D, TRELLIS.2); notes that generated topology lacks deformation loops at joints. Published 17 July 2026.

refs.title: Qwen-Image Technical Report
refs.note: The image model family CharForge draws references with (Qwen-Image 2.1 checkpoint, via ComfyUI).

refs.title: Qwen-Image-2.0 Technical Report
refs.note: The 2.x series whose 2.1 checkpoint is the default reference model; research-only licence.

refs.title: MiniMax H3 (reference-to-video), ComfyUI packaging
refs.note: Generates a video of the character doing a move from its reference image; run as a community w4a8 fine-tune. MiniMax H3 Community License (territorial limits).

refs.title: ViTPose: Simple Vision Transformer Baselines for Human Pose Estimation
refs.note: 17-point body pose on video frames and on renders (checkpoint usyd-community/vitpose-base-simple).

refs.title: Effective Whole-body Pose Estimation with Two-stages Distillation
refs.note: 133 whole-body points; CharForge uses its 21-point hands.

refs.title: DINOv3
refs.note: The image encoder TRELLIS.2 conditions on (ViT-L/16).

refs.title: SegFormer: Simple and Efficient Design for Semantic Segmentation with Transformers
refs.note: The architecture of the human parser that labels the mesh's parts (checkpoint fashn-ai/fashn-human-parser).

refs.title: U²-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient Object Detection
refs.note: The background remover (via rembg) that cuts out references and video frames.

refs.title: Fast Optical Flow using Dense Inverse Search
refs.note: Aligns the reference to renders of the mesh during texture projection (OpenCV's DIS).

refs.title: Dynamic Programming Algorithm Optimization for Spoken Word Recognition
refs.venue: IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing 26(1)
refs.note: Dynamic time warping, for matching a video's pose sequence to library clips.

refs.title: Joint-Dependent Local Deformations for Hand Animation and Object Grasping
refs.note: Linear blend skinning, what glTF and FBX consumers apply.

refs.title: Skinning with Dual Quaternions
refs.venue: ACM SIGGRAPH Symposium on Interactive 3D Graphics and Games (I3D)
refs.note: The playground's skinning, which keeps bent joints from collapsing.

refs.title: Geodesic Voxel Binding for Production Character Meshes
refs.venue: ACM SIGGRAPH/Eurographics Symposium on Computer Animation (SCA)
refs.note: Skin weights from distances through the voxelised body, the idea CharForge's weights follow.

refs.title: SMPL: A Skinned Multi-Person Linear Model
refs.note: The parametric body most human-recovery methods fit; CharForge fits the character's own skeleton instead.

refs.title: Keep it SMPL: Automatic Estimation of 3D Human Pose and Shape from a Single Image
refs.note: Optimisation of a body model against 2D joints with priors - the analysis-by-synthesis idea the refine stage applies to the character's own mesh.

refs.title: End-to-end Recovery of Human Shape and Pose
refs.note: Regression of body pose from one image.

refs.title: Humans in 4D: Reconstructing and Tracking Humans with Transformers
refs.note: Video human mesh recovery and tracking - an alternative to our retrieval-and-fit.

refs.title: WHAM: Reconstructing World-grounded Humans with Accurate 3D Motion
refs.note: World-grounded 3D motion from video, with foot contact - a candidate replacement for depth borrowed from the library.

refs.title: Poisson Image Editing
refs.note: Gradient-domain blending, used at texture seams by CharacterGen and Make-A-Character.

refs.title: VDB: High-Resolution Sparse Volumes with Dynamic Topology
refs.note: Level sets for the solid, the arm cut and the modelled hands.

refs.title: Blender 5.2
refs.note: Rigging, retargeting, baking, rendering and export, all scripted headless.

refs.title: ComfyUI
refs.note: Runs the image and video models.

refs.title: Gemma 4 (e4b), via Ollama
refs.note: The local language model that writes a few words out into a full character description.

refs.title: glTF 2.0 Specification
refs.note: The package format, with FBX.

refs.title: three.js
refs.note: The playground's renderer and animation mixer.
